  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 12, 2019

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the August 05, 2019, meeting.

  2. Applied Best Practices – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  consulting work.

  3. Shelli Boone - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for services as the
  Artistic Director for the Willie Agee Playhouse.

  4. Remy Moose Manley LLP – Executive session to discuss payment for professional legal
  services.

Closed Session - Confidential
  1. Closed session-Confidential-Attorney/Client Privileged; Executive closed session Claims
  Review Committee with Legal Counsel regarding pending litigation pursuant to California
  Government Code §54956.9(a)); Karina Gomez vs City of Inglewood.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 12, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers, 9th floor at
11:37 a.m.:

  Members Present: Aisha Thompson, City Clerk Department
  Wanda Brown, Treasure’s Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Ken Campos, City Attorney

  Staff Present:  Sharon Koike, Finance Department
  Barnes, Sabrina, Parks and Rec Department
  Peter Puglese, Public Works Department
  Jenny Hsieh, Legal Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of August 05, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Applied Best Practices – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommended settlement payment of $2,905.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Shelli Boone – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $5,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  4. Remy Moose Manley, LLP - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommended settlement payment of $607.50. Motion carried unanimously.

  1. Closed Session- Confidential
  Karina Gomez vs City of Inglewood- A motion was moved and second to recommend
  settlement payment of $7,500.00.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 12:08 p.m.

Adjournment
